sources.summary: Architecture studio Snøhetta added tunnelling playgrounds to Sky House, the final of four clubhouses that make up its Pavilia Farm residential development in Tai Wai, Hong Kong. Called Sky House, the clubhouse was designed as a playground and fitness centre for all ages and combines play spaces with workout areas for senior residences.
